description: This Java class 'CameraPreviewActivity' manages camera access and preview display in an Android app, handling camera initialization, error handling, and resource release.

classes.name: CameraPreviewActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages camera preview, handles camera availability, and manages camera resource lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes camera, sets up preview or error message based on camera availability.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases camera resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Safely attempts to open and return a camera instance by ID.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it is currently held.
